project.name: KHKD - Tom Tit
project.description: Vietnamese science-horror Reel — tom tit cu dam 4400 do C
project.story: The mantis shrimp (tom tit in Vietnamese, eaten as seafood delicacy) has a club-like raptorial appendage that punches at 80 km/h via a spring-loaded mechanism. The strike is so fast it creates a cavitation bubble in water that briefly reaches 4400 degrees Celsius and emits visible light (sonoluminescence). It uses this to smash open crab and snail shells. Despite being smaller than a finger, it has one of the most powerful biological weapons in nature.

characters.name: Crab Prey

characters.name: Vietnamese Seafood Plate
